display_name: 原生DAOT＋RC4与仅动力博弈三seed对照
description: 3行原生F0配方DAOT＋RC4；18行仅动力博弈SIM/EG/CF/TR/XT/DRIC。共同source物理角色；新18行与原联合18行同seed、同预算及响应参数，移除全部DAOT/RC4功能；原生配方作独立recipe比较。
authorization: 用户2026-09-17明确要求启动DAOT＋RC4三种子及仅动力博弈以上方法三种子进行对比

permissions.query_use: none in training; frozen final predictions then independent scoring
permissions.claim_scope: previously exposed benchmark exploratory recipe and ablation comparison; no blind confirmation

checkpoint.provenance_verdict: NO_EXTERNAL_CHECKPOINT_OR_TEACHER; every row exact physical-role check at startup
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed final E200; no target feedback

execution.stop_rule: A technical row failure holds new submissions and drains healthy rows; no performance stop; no automatic retrain or target selection

expected_artifacts: frozen predictions and independent scores after training

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: fixed E200; same opaque target package, batch256, eval seed392005
